parameters.query:
SELECT
  a.id              AS application_id,
  a.status          AS status,
  a.answers         AS answers,
  a.match_score     AS match_score,
  p.name            AS cand_name,
  p.city            AS cand_city,
  p.experience      AS cand_experience,
  p.min_hourly_rate AS cand_min_rate,
  r.name            AS restaurant_name,
  r.mandatory_shifts AS mandatory_shifts,
  r.shift_commitment_min AS commit_min,
  r.shift_commitment_max AS commit_max,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(r.recruitment_whatsapp, ''), r.phone) AS wa_target
FROM applications a
JOIN profiles p    ON p.id = a.user_id
JOIN restaurants r ON r.id = a.restaurant_id
WHERE a.id = $1;
